description: This file defines the PdfFont class, a base class representing a font in a PDF document within the PDFsharp library. It includes properties and methods related to font descriptors, encoding, character mapping, and ToUnicode maps.

classes.name: PdfFont
classes.description: Represents the base class of a PDF font, handling font descriptors, encoding, and character mappings.

methods.name: PdfFont(PdfDocument document)
methods.description: Constructor initializing the PdfFont instance with a PdfDocument.

methods.name: AddChars(CodePointGlyphIndexPair[] codePoints)
methods.description: Adds character-to-glyph mappings to the font and its cmap info.
